title: CellChatESS: Efficient Signal Streaming for CellChat inference
description: CellChatESS 0.2.2 for triMean-based non-spatial RNA inference. The accompanying revision evidence records comparisons against original CellChat 2.2.0.9001 and AutoZyme 0.3.1, input validation, the empirical p-value checks and single-threaded performance measurements.
